svg.title: Rivers and drainage basins of Irad
svg.desc: The three closed drainage systems of Irad, the Chu, the Talas and the Syr Darya system, and the ground with no surface outflow. The basins are computed from SRTM relief (AWS Terrain Tiles, public domain): each point is followed downhill to the river it reaches. Border of Irad and canals: Kartalar map data. Base map: Natural Earth (public domain); Chu, Talas and Chatkal rivers © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
